title: Snap发布Specs智能眼镜 售价2195美元起
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Snap just held a big showcase for its specs, augmented reality glasses, and shared new details on how consumers can get their own parallel to this year,
segments.zh: Snap刚刚为其智能眼镜和增强现实眼镜举办了一场大型展示会，并分享了消费者如何获得自己产品的细节，与今年类似。

segments.en: at a steep price of $2,195 that clearly makes these a gadget for early adopters.
segments.zh: 售价高达2195美元，显然这些是面向早期采用者的产品。

segments.en: We got the chance to go hands-on with the specs and try out a number of mixed reality capabilities that overlay digital experiences onto the real world.
segments.zh: 我们有机会亲身体验了这款眼镜，并尝试了多种混合现实功能，将数字体验叠加到现实世界中。

segments.en: You can use them to improve your basketball game, play a virtual game of dominoes with a friend, watch movies on traveling, or use the glasses to create a secondary virtual display for your laptop.
segments.zh: 你可以用它们来提升篮球水平，与朋友玩虚拟多米诺骨牌，在旅途中看电影，或者用眼镜为笔记本电脑创建辅助虚拟显示器。

segments.en: And sure, they can take photos and record videos too. Now, the interface is pretty sleek. You just look at your palm to bring up the home screen and from there, choose an app, or what Snap calls lenses. These glasses understand
segments.zh: 当然，它们也可以拍照和录像。界面非常流畅。你只需看着手掌就能调出主屏幕，然后从中选择应用或Snap所称的镜头。这些眼镜能理解

segments.en: 3D space and can accurately overlay software onto tables or anywhere else in your surroundings in real time. Spectre unique in that all of the tech and computing power is contained directly
segments.zh: 3D空间，并能实时准确地将软件叠加到桌子或周围任何地方。Spectre的独特之处在于所有技术和计算能力都直接包含

segments.en: inside the glasses. There's no tethered puck or dangling battery to worry about, unlike with an Apple Vision Pro. This does mean that they're pretty thick compared to something
segments.zh: 在眼镜内部。没有需要担心的连接 puck 或悬垂电池，不像Vision Pro。这确实意味着它们比Rayban metaglasses之类的产品要厚一些，

segments.en: like Rayban metaglasses, but they're mostly comfortable during a brief hands-on session.
segments.zh: 但在短暂的亲身体验中，它们大多很舒适。

segments.en: Starting later this fall, you can buy specs yourself directly from Snap, but most people are going to want to try them before spending over $2,000, so some Verizon stores will have hands-on
segments.zh: 从今年秋季晚些时候开始，你可以直接从Snap购买眼镜，但大多数人会想先试戴再花超过2000美元，所以一些Verizon门店将提供亲身体验
